column1: # Names defined more than once across libniji's installed headers on next when the duplicate-definition check came
# (spec/tools/header_checks/dup.py, HEADERS-FRAGMENTS, 2026-11-26): kind (macro, typedef, tag, enumerator), name, and
# the files under libc-include/ that define it (comma-separated, sorted), over every configuration the header checks
# cover. Nearly all are identical macro definitions the generator emits in each header that shows the name (one
# header does not include the other). A name defined in exactly its listed files passes; defined in any other file
# set it fails, and so does a row that no longer occurs. The list only shrinks: a story never adds a row here, and a
# story that removes a duplicate removes its row. Sorted by kind, then name.
